receipts.title: Observational equivalence of omitted implicit helper and incorrect neighboring fill in frozen-model skill repair
receipts.strongest_reduction: generic partial identification / fault localization remains a sufficient explanation until released matched units establish same-observable, incompatible repair targets
receipts.reason: The primary paper already defines IRF and RRO as distinct root causes, uses paired execution trajectories for attribution, and reports high automatic root-cause matching. The audited primary/full-text material does not expose a downloadable released trace/label asset containing matched units with the same observable outcome/trace/differential evidence but incompatible correct repair targets. The existence claim needed by this near-miss is therefore unsupported, not falsified.
avoid: rephrasing IRF-versus-RRO confusion as a new identifiability paper without released matched units
claiming trajectory ambiguity alone when the source already performs paired trajectory attribution
launching new expensive agent rollouts only to manufacture support for the problem formulation
receipts.reopen_only_if: A released or provenance-audited dataset supplies at least one non-synthetic matched unit in which observable outcome, execution trace, and differential evidence are information-equivalent while the correct repairs are incompatible (for example add omitted helper versus correct neighboring fill), and a generic partial-identification/fault-localization baseline using the same information does not absorb the residual claim.

receipts.title: Retrieval-Mediated Technical Debt in Fixed-Weight Self-Evolving Agent Runtimes
receipts.strongest_reduction: skill technical debt with persistent skill-library defects affecting future retrieval, composition, execution, and maintenance
receipts.reason: Current primary work already treats skill technical debt as a long-lived skill-library maintenance object whose defects degrade later retrieval, composition, and execution. Splitting the realization mechanism into validity/obsolescence and retrieval exposure changes the accounting of when debt is behaviorally realized, but does not yet define an irreducible paper object beyond the same technical-debt lifecycle under identical information.
avoid: renaming skill technical debt as retrieval-mediated debt
adding retrieval exposure as a second axis without an ex-ante residual prediction
claiming stored-but-unretrieved or obsolete-and-over-retrieved artifacts as novelty by itself
receipts.reopen_only_if: New primary evidence supports an ex-ante same-information prediction about access-mediated debt that a SkillOps-style technical-debt/maintenance model with the same artifact validity, retrieval, composition, execution, and maintenance observations cannot express; a two-axis relabeling alone does not reopen the basin.

receipts.title: Endogenous Trace Observability: Separating Execution-Process Correction from Skill-Package Effects in Fixed-Weight Self-Improving Agents
receipts.strongest_reduction: treatment-induced confounding plus joint treatment-monitoring interventions / informative monitoring processes
receipts.reason: The candidate's residual claim is that a skill edit changes not only execution but the future diagnostic observation map used to evaluate that edit. Mature longitudinal causal inference already treats treatment-induced confounding and non-systematic monitoring as identification problems, and explicitly formulates joint treatment/monitoring interventions. Replacing treatment with a textual skill and monitoring with future trace exposure instantiates that mature object but does not yet add an ex-ante prediction that the same-information causal model cannot express.
avoid: renaming treatment-induced monitoring or measurement endogeneity as endogenous trace observability
claiming novelty from a textual skill changing which future logs are observed without a residual beyond joint treatment-monitoring causal inference

receipts.reopen_only_if: A new agent-specific primary phenomenon yields an ex-ante prediction under identical treatment, monitoring, state, task-distribution, and trace-availability information that cannot be expressed by treatment-induced confounding, joint treatment-monitoring interventions, informative monitoring/missingness, or performative/adaptive data-collection models; textual-policy terminology alone does not reopen the basin.

receipts.title: Contaminated self-tests make skill-failure causes non-identifiable in test-time skill refinement
receipts.strongest_reduction: self-generated verification inherits the defect or in-band information channel under test, so externally grounded or specification-independent verification is required
receipts.reason: Current primary work directly shows that buggy code can misguide LLM-generated tests into asserting the same erroneous behavior while suppressing bug-finding tests, and that long-running agents' in-band self-evaluation can accept stagnation or regression until an externally grounded signal is introduced. Agent-generated tests are also empirically observed to function mainly as in-band observational feedback channels. This already instantiates the candidate's structural contamination claim that a self-test generated through the suspect artifact or workflow may fail to supply independent evidence.
avoid: renaming buggy-code-induced test misguidance or in-band self-evaluation bias as a new intervention-contamination object
claiming that more self-tests solve causal ambiguity without specifying an independent information source
using skill/workflow vocabulary to restate the need for specification-based or externally grounded verification
receipts.reopen_only_if: New primary evidence demonstrates a contamination-induced non-identifiability residual that persists after matching test budget, using a specification-independent or externally grounded test generator, and controlling evaluator ancestry; the residual must not reduce to buggy-artifact test misguidance, in-band self-evaluation bias, verifier exogeneity, or generic active-testing partial identification.

blocked_objects.title: Selective fresh-session harm from one frozen skill library does not by itself identify a latent carryover-activation mechanism
avoid: re-proposing the certified-dead-end mechanism without satisfying its reopen condition: Selective fresh-session harm from one frozen skill library does not by itself identify a latent carryover-activation mechanism
using the negative experiment metric alone as the reason for the dead end
discarding the opposite principle/search seed instead of testing its fresh-evidence boundary
blocked_objects.strongest_reduction: On the current provenance-frozen AutoSkill × SkillMisevo smoke, the selective P19 harm is already explained by observable persistent-artifact uptake under task-conditioned applicability. P19 is harmful with the evolved library and non-harmful with the exact empty-library control, while the evolved trace executes eight git-hook write/execute-class operations and the empty control executes zero. P20 and P21 receive the same five-skill library but execute zero such hook operations and are non-harmful. Therefore the observed selectivity does not require a separate latent carryover-activation principle once task context, injected artifact content, and executed uptake are observable.
blocked_objects.problem_text: The standalone claim that selective fresh-session harm across P19/P20/P21 under one frozen AutoSkill library reveals a new context-conditioned latent activation mechanism beyond ordinary persistent-artifact uptake, instruction following, and task-conditioned applicability.
blocked_objects.reason: The current smoke contains a real positive persistent-library effect on P19, but its selective task dependence is already compatible with observable context-conditioned artifact uptake. It does not support a standalone latent carryover-activation mechanism beyond mature retrieval-utilization/instruction-following and effect-heterogeneity explanations.
blocked_objects.reopen_only_if: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched units that hold the frozen library, task-artifact compatibility, and observable action-level uptake fixed yet show different fresh-session harm, or with harm that persists despite absence of corresponding artifact uptake, and show that same-information retrieval-utilization/instruction-following plus task-conditioned effect-heterogeneity baselines cannot express the residual.

counter_explanation.statement: On the current provenance-frozen AutoSkill × SkillMisevo smoke, the selective P19 harm is already explained by observable persistent-artifact uptake under task-conditioned applicability. P19 is harmful with the evolved library and non-harmful with the exact empty-library control, while the evolved trace executes eight git-hook write/execute-class operations and the empty control executes zero. P20 and P21 receive the same five-skill library but execute zero such hook operations and are non-harmful. Therefore the observed selectivity does not require a separate latent carryover-activation principle once task context, injected artifact content, and executed uptake are observable.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: With the persistent library fixed, fresh-session harm should track observable task-artifact applicability and realized artifact uptake. After matching the task, injected artifact set, semantic compatibility, and action-level uptake, a standalone latent activation mechanism predicts no additional residual unless matched units with the same observable uptake state still differ in harm.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: Persistent-artifact carryover is mediated by context-conditioned artifact uptake unless a residual survives after matching observable task-artifact compatibility and executed uptake.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search for provenance-audited matched fresh-session units with the same frozen library, comparable task-artifact compatibility, and the same observable action-level uptake but different harm outcomes, or for harm that occurs without corresponding artifact uptake. Require the strongest retrieval-utilization/instruction-following and effect-heterogeneity baselines to fail under the same information before proposing a new carryover-activation mechanism.
counter_explanation.scope: Current corrected AutoSkill × SkillMisevo smoke only: P19/P20/P21 persistence probes, one frozen five-skill library for all three probes, exact empty-library P controls, and the current artifact hashes recorded below.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: No persistent-state effect: ruled out locally because P19 is harmful with the evolved library and non-harmful under the exact empty-library control on the same probe.
Different persistent libraries across P probes: ruled out because P19, P20, and P21 currently mount the same five injected skill names from the same frozen store.

The retrieved_unsafe=false field proves no skill uptake: ruled out because the released harness defines that field from explicit unsafe-skill slug mentions in assistant output, not from mounted/injected skill provenance or action-level uptake.

A hidden mechanism is needed to explain selective P19 behavior: not supported because the evolved P19 trace has eight observable git-hook write/execute-class operations versus zero in its empty control, while P20 and P21 have zero such operations and no harm.
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched units that hold the frozen library, task-artifact compatibility, and observable action-level uptake fixed yet show different fresh-session harm, or with harm that persists despite absence of corresponding artifact uptake, and show that same-information retrieval-utilization/instruction-following plus task-conditioned effect-heterogeneity baselines cannot express the residual.

opposite_search_asset_evidence.title: AutoSkill first-party retrieval, usage, and lineage runtime
empirical_facts: AutoSkill's OpenClaw usage tracker preserves selected_for_context_ids and selected_for_use_ids in a pending retrieval snapshot, separating retrieved/selected artifacts from later realized use.

The first-party agent-end path records explicit used_skill_ids and inferred_used_skill_ids together with success/task_success/objective_met for the same session, so selected-for-use, observed uptake, and downstream outcome are separately observable states.

SkillEvo reconstructs per-skill replay pools from online and offline provenance, binds them to lineage_id and skill_id/version history, and persists replay, judgment, promotion, and provenance artifacts.

blocked_objects.title: Relevance-conditioned evidence debt under selective evidence access
avoid: re-proposing the certified-dead-end mechanism without satisfying its reopen condition: Relevance-conditioned evidence debt under selective evidence access
using the negative experiment metric alone as the reason for the dead end
discarding the opposite principle/search seed instead of testing its fresh-evidence boundary
blocked_objects.strongest_reduction: DocAtlas already makes unresolved, relevance-conditioned information gaps an explicit mutable control state rather than relying on page-coverage quantity. Its structured Note is n=(found,evidence,plan), where plan states remaining information gaps; subsequent Search consumes accumulated findings and may issue a new sub-question, and Selective Evidence Access explicitly allows reading pages from unresolved gaps recorded in memory. Thus the correct opposite principle discovered from the P06 coverage-count dead end is already a first-class current-source information-seeking mechanism, not a new standalone evidence-debt object.
blocked_objects.problem_text: The standalone paper problem/method object that replaces page-coverage quantity with an explicit relevance-conditioned 'evidence debt' or unresolved-information-gap state to decide whether a long-document agent should continue searching/reading before answering.
blocked_objects.reason: The P06 coverage-count realization failed because page quantity is not answer-evidence sufficiency. That opposite principle remains scientifically correct, but turning it into a standalone relevance-conditioned evidence-debt state is absorbed by DocAtlas's existing mutable information-gap planning and Search/Read loop. The dead-end is authorized by the current-source same-information reduction, not by negative exploratory screens.
blocked_objects.reopen_only_if: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched states that are equivalent under DocAtlas-style found/evidence/plan, mutable search/index state, explored-page history, and budget, but have different counterfactual answer-change risk and different optimal answer-versus-continue actions; the residual must also survive generic value-of-information/active sequential testing under the same information.

counter_explanation.statement: DocAtlas already makes unresolved, relevance-conditioned information gaps an explicit mutable control state rather than relying on page-coverage quantity. Its structured Note is n=(found,evidence,plan), where plan states remaining information gaps; subsequent Search consumes accumulated findings and may issue a new sub-question, and Selective Evidence Access explicitly allows reading pages from unresolved gaps recorded in memory. Thus the correct opposite principle discovered from the P06 coverage-count dead end is already a first-class current-source information-seeking mechanism, not a new standalone evidence-debt object.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: Under the same observed question, read evidence, note state, and budget, a policy equipped with DocAtlas-style remaining-gap plan state plus mutable Search/Read can express the decision to continue evidence acquisition without any separate scalar/page-coverage evidence-debt variable. A standalone evidence-debt formulation has no residual unless two states that are equivalent under the full found/evidence/plan plus mutable-search information require different answer/continue decisions for reasons the current-source state cannot express.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: Evidence sufficiency is relevance-conditioned, but relevance-conditioned unresolved information is already representable as mutable plan/search state. Novelty requires a residual beyond explicit remaining-gap state, not a renamed debt score.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search for matched selective-evidence states with the same question, read evidence, source-attributed findings, remaining-gap plan, mutable search state, and budget, but different counterfactual answer-change risk under additional evidence. Only if this same-information pair yields different optimal answer-versus-continue decisions does an answer-change-risk object survive beyond DocAtlas-style mutable information seeking.
counter_explanation.scope: DocAtlas arXiv:2608.07527, especially Sections 3.1-3.3: mutable Search state, Selective Evidence Access, and Note=(found,evidence,plan) where plan records remaining information gaps.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: Page-coverage quantity as the missing control state: the protocol-valid P06 run showed coverage metadata did not selectively identify answer-evidence gaps, and the original principle readjudication established a structural indistinguishability witness for coverage-only states.

Static lexical/dense retrieval quality as the full explanation: on the frozen 64 answerable MMLongBench-Doc units, BM25, MiniLM dense, and hybrid retrieval all left substantial complete-evidence gaps at top-6; even hybrid top-20 recovered only 31/47 original BM25-gap units completely. These diagnostics are supportive only and do not authorize the dead-end decision.

Answer-conditioned retrieval similarity as a distinct residual: on the frozen 20 answer-hypothesis units, question-only and question-plus-answer MiniLM top-6 both achieved 9/20 complete evidence coverage, so simple answer-conditioned semantic similarity did not create a new control object. This diagnostic is supportive only.
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched states that are equivalent under DocAtlas-style found/evidence/plan, mutable search/index state, explored-page history, and budget, but have different counterfactual answer-change risk and different optimal answer-versus-continue actions; the residual must also survive generic value-of-information/active sequential testing under the same information.

blocked_objects.title: Frozen no-skill anchors make reciprocal metric-skill coevolution observationally indistinguishable from one-way metric-to-skill coupling
avoid: re-proposing the certified-dead-end mechanism without satisfying its reopen condition: Frozen no-skill anchors make reciprocal metric-skill coevolution observationally indistinguishable from one-way metric-to-skill coupling
using the negative experiment metric alone as the reason for the dead end
discarding the opposite principle/search seed instead of testing its fresh-evidence boundary
blocked_objects.strongest_reduction: Reciprocal coupling is not latent in the released Double Ratchet object. The first-party implementation constructs dev_items, locked, and train once before alternating phases and later metric phases reuse those same objects, while skill phases consume the current metric through make_expr_grader. Because skill-phase outputs are not inputs to the metric update operator, the released causal graph is directly one-way rather than observationally ambiguous.
blocked_objects.problem_text: The standalone identifiability claim that the released Double Ratchet implementation leaves reciprocal metric-skill coupling observationally ambiguous even though the first-party update graph explicitly omits any skill-output-to-metric-data edge.
blocked_objects.reason: The released Double Ratchet implementation has directly observable one-way metric-to-skill coupling at the data-update level. Treating that structural fact itself as an identifiability problem is a dead end; the scientifically meaningful follow-up is whether such one-way coupling causes a nontrivial consequence beyond generic distribution shift.
blocked_objects.reopen_only_if: Reopen only with a preregistered downstream consequence of the missing reciprocal edge, such as held-out evaluator selection/regret under actor-induced distribution shift, and require the effect to survive a same-information generic distribution-shift/online-adaptation baseline and a matched compute budget.

counter_explanation.statement: Reciprocal coupling is not latent in the released Double Ratchet object. The first-party implementation constructs dev_items, locked, and train once before alternating phases and later metric phases reuse those same objects, while skill phases consume the current metric through make_expr_grader. Because skill-phase outputs are not inputs to the metric update operator, the released causal graph is directly one-way rather than observationally ambiguous.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: For the released implementation, changing skill state or skill-phase outputs while holding the frozen metric-phase dev_items/train objects and metric random/model inputs fixed cannot alter a later metric update through a reciprocal data path, because no such input edge exists. Any measured metric change must flow through some other explicitly introduced state or instrumentation change.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: Causal reciprocity is a structural property of update operators, not an identifiability problem when the implementation exposes the dependency graph. A missing reciprocal edge becomes scientifically interesting only through a downstream consequence that survives generic distribution-shift, stale-supervisor, or alternating-optimization reductions.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search for self-evolving systems where actor updates materially shift the error/data distribution seen by a supervisor or evaluator, and test whether a frozen or one-way evaluator incurs held-out selection/regret consequences that cannot be explained by a same-information covariate-shift or online-adaptation baseline. Do not claim novelty from merely observing that one update operator omits the other component's outputs.
counter_explanation.scope: Double Ratchet first-party repository commit 0f14e910d361196422d9b938f45280919952d4fd, especially evalratchet/coevolve.py::_prepare, run_coevolution, run_adaptive_coevolution, make_real_skill_loop, and evalratchet/evolve.py::evolve_metric_expr.
counter_explanation.structural_witness: run_coevolution/run_adaptive_coevolution call _prepare once before all alternating phases. _prepare materializes dev_items, locked, and train from frozen no-skill solver outputs. Every later metric phase passes those same objects to evolve_metric_expr. Skill phases instead receive state.metric_expr through make_expr_grader, and their outputs are returned only as phase reports/progress summaries; they are not inserted into dev_items or train for the next metric phase.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: Reciprocal data refresh through skill reports: phase reports update logging/progress summaries but are not assigned into dev_items or train used by evolve_metric_expr.
Hidden eval_locked feedback: eval_locked is report-only for the metric loop and does not create the missing skill-output-to-metric-data edge.

Warm skill-bank coupling: the skill bank persists across skill phases, but persistence changes the actor side only; the metric training examples remain the frozen no-skill objects prepared before alternation.
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a preregistered downstream consequence of the missing reciprocal edge, such as held-out evaluator selection/regret under actor-induced distribution shift, and require the effect to survive a same-information generic distribution-shift/online-adaptation baseline and a matched compute budget.

opposite_search_asset_evidence.title: Double Ratchet first-party metric/skill co-evolution implementation
empirical_facts: run_coevolution calls _prepare once before alternating phases, and later metric phases reuse the same dev_items, locked, and train objects created from frozen no-skill outputs.

Skill phases consume the current metric through make_expr_grader and update the warm skill bank, but their outputs are not inserted into the metric-phase dev_items or train objects used by subsequent evolve_metric_expr calls.
The released adaptive controller gates on metric maturity and metric-graded skill train progress while eval_locked remains report-only for the metric side.

blocked_objects.title: Coverage-note starvation under selective evidence access in document agents
avoid: re-proposing the certified-dead-end mechanism without satisfying its reopen condition: Coverage-note starvation under selective evidence access in document agents
using the negative experiment metric alone as the reason for the dead end
discarding the opposite principle/search seed instead of testing its fresh-evidence boundary
blocked_objects.strongest_reduction: Page coverage is not answer-evidence sufficiency. A coverage certificate that reveals only retrieved page ids, total pages, coverage ratio, unchecked-page count, and FULL/PARTIAL status does not reveal whether any unread page contains answer-relevant evidence. The target gap/covered distinction is defined post hoc with hidden benchmark evidence_pages, so the P06 treatment does not expose the latent variable that distinguishes the two strata.
blocked_objects.problem_text: The standalone P06 mechanism claiming that page-coverage certification, with no answer-relevance information beyond the same retrieved snippets/question, selectively exposes hidden answer-evidence gaps relative to covered-answerable cases.
blocked_objects.reason: The frozen P06 realization is a dead end because relevance-agnostic page-coverage quantity cannot identify the hidden answer-evidence gap it is supposed to selectively repair. The experiment supplies compatible behavioral evidence, but the dead-end decision is authorized by the stronger information-structure witness, not by the negative metric alone.
blocked_objects.reopen_only_if: Reopen only with a preregistered treatment that exposes or preserves relevance-conditioned evidence debt without using benchmark answer/evidence truth at decision time, and show a selective held-out gap effect beyond the strongest same-information uncertainty/conservatism baseline under matched retrieval and context budget.

counter_explanation.statement: Page coverage is not answer-evidence sufficiency. A coverage certificate that reveals only retrieved page ids, total pages, coverage ratio, unchecked-page count, and FULL/PARTIAL status does not reveal whether any unread page contains answer-relevant evidence. The target gap/covered distinction is defined post hoc with hidden benchmark evidence_pages, so the P06 treatment does not expose the latent variable that distinguishes the two strata.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: Under matched question, retrieved snippets, and inference budget, adding relevance-agnostic page-coverage metadata can at most induce a generic uncertainty/conservatism shift. It has no information-theoretic basis for selectively increasing RETRIEVE_MORE/ABSTAIN on hidden answer-evidence-gap units more than on covered-answerable units. A selective residual requires an observable relevance-conditioned evidence-debt signal, not coverage quantity alone.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: Evidence sufficiency is relevance-conditioned, not coverage-conditioned.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search for an observable relevance-conditioned evidence-debt state: a state that predicts whether unread evidence can change the answer, is invariant to adding irrelevant unread pages, and beats a same-information generic uncertainty/conservatism baseline under matched retrieval and context budget.
counter_explanation.scope: Frozen P06-COVERAGE-STARVATION-V2 information set: same question and raw retrieved pages across policies; coverage_certified adds only retrieved ids, total pages, coverage ratio, unchecked-page count and FULL/PARTIAL certificate; benchmark evidence_pages remain forbidden from retrieval/prompt and are used only for posthoc stratification/evaluation.
counter_explanation.structural_witness: Construct two latent document worlds with the same observed question, same retrieved snippets, same retrieved page ids, same total page count and therefore the same coverage certificate, but place the decisive answer evidence on an unread page in one world and no decisive answer evidence on unread pages in the other. The coverage-certified policy receives identical coverage information in both worlds while the posthoc gap label differs. Therefore coverage quantity alone cannot identify answer-relevant omission.

protocol invalidity: the final analysis marked protocol_valid=true
simple lack of behavioral response: the coverage-certified policy shifted the primary state on covered-answerable units by +0.11765, so the intervention was behaviorally active
selective gap benefit hidden by noise: the observed gap shift was only +0.02128, the gap-vs-covered difference-in-differences was -0.09637, and the paired gap McNemar p-value was 1.0

blocked_objects.strongest_reduction: In the released Double Ratchet implementation, eval_locked is a measurement-only sink: it is scored only after the round-best metric has already been selected by the dev-agreement × train-coverage objective, and the source explicitly states that eval_locked never selects, gates, rolls back, or otherwise influences the loop. blocked_objects.reason: The locked-set-reuse candidate is a dead end for the released Double Ratchet loop because the proposed treatment is causally disconnected from evolution. This conclusion is authorized by a source-code structural invariance witness, not by a failed experiment.
blocked_objects.reopen_only_if: Reopen only for a system or explicitly modeled outer loop where a reused evaluation signal is demonstrably consumed by a later selection/update transition, with the feedback edge frozen before outcomes and a same-information rotating/fresh-probe control.

counter_explanation.statement: In the released Double Ratchet implementation, eval_locked is a measurement-only sink: it is scored only after the round-best metric has already been selected by the dev-agreement × train-coverage objective, and the source explicitly states that eval_locked never selects, gates, rolls back, or otherwise influences the loop. counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: Under identical model calls, train/eval_dev inputs, candidate expressions, random seed, and loop state, two executions that differ only in eval_locked membership must produce the same selected metric expressions and evolution state round by round; only the reported locked agreement/eval records may differ.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: A validation signal can induce adaptive evaluator overfitting only if it has a causal write path into selection, gating, rollback, synthesis, or another state transition; report-only evaluation is trajectory-invariant by construction.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search for self-evolving agent systems where the same evaluator/validation set is repeatedly reused and its score actually feeds back into update selection, gating, rollback, memory admission, or artifact promotion. Test whether fresh or rotating hidden probes change the selected evolution trajectory under matched information and budget, rather than studying report-only held-out sets.
counter_explanation.scope: Double Ratchet first-party repository commit 0f14e910d361196422d9b938f45280919952d4fd, specifically scripts/run_metric_evo.py and evalratchet/evolve.py under the released metric-evolution loop.
counter_explanation.structural_witness: The source's evolve_metric_expr() selects round_best/best from combined dev_agreement × train_coverage first, then calls _report_locked(best['expr'], r). _report_locked() writes held-out statistics and eval records but its return value is only appended to history. No selection/gating/rollback branch consumes locked_report. The function docstring and runner note both explicitly state eval_locked is report-only and never influences the loop.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: Locked-set rollback: the released metric loop explicitly has no metric rollback and locked agreement is not read by the rollback or acceptance logic.
Locked-set gating: validity gating is applied to candidate expressions before held-out reporting and uses eval_dev/dev-derived quantities, not eval_locked.
Naive-arm feedback: --naive disables the fail-closed eval_dev anchor and discriminating validity gate; it does not make eval_locked selection-facing.
Elite-history leakage: elites are ranked by the combined selection score; locked_report is recorded only after best selection and is not added to elite scoring or synthesis inputs.
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only for a system or explicitly modeled outer loop where a reused evaluation signal is demonstrably consumed by a later selection/update transition, with the feedback edge frozen before outcomes and a same-information rotating/fresh-probe control.

positive_residual_asset_evidence.title: Persistent memory effects survive two failed mechanism realizations
empirical_facts: The frozen 72-unit, three-arm memory-effect table contains 11 raw controlled nonzero effects; 10 units retain exact first-divergence route and effect-sign reproducibility on matched hardware.

The historical B-9 transport representation was stopped at method development because its nonzero-sign AUC was 0.3214 versus 0.6429 for the strongest simple same-information baseline; the parent effect phenomenon was not rejected.

The subsequent C2 earliest-divergent-action mechanism had 10 execution-valid strict units but only 2/10 nonzero controlled action contrasts and no preregistered same-memory cross-context sign reversal.
The full pre-divergence policy decision context was reproducible for all 10 C2 units, so the C2 mechanism negative is not explained by replay or decision-context invalidity.
failed_mechanisms: source/target transport representation used by the historical B-9 method realization
earliest-divergent-action controlled mediator used by trajectory-mediated-memory-effect-transport C2

search_contract.question: What prospective pre-outcome mechanism can explain context-dependent persistent-memory endpoint effects while remaining consistent with both failed transport representation and failed earliest-action mediation?

failure of the earliest divergent action to carry the parent endpoint effect

treating this asset as novelty, Problem-Gate, Method, P0, GPU, or full-experiment authority

rows.original_problem: Model-trigger-skill-context acceptance object with a compositional-risk veto for evolved skill deployment.
rows.collision_reason: The original novelty bundle is occupied in pieces that together reproduce the claimed paper object: lifecycle governance already maps verification to graduated deployment permissions; dependency/context-aware skill-chain risk is explicit; conditional dormant attacks and model-dependent skill behavior are already empirical first-class objects. A new install/update/block/escalate acceptance object therefore reduces to a contextual security/utility policy unless it proves a stronger impossibility or decision-theoretic phenomenon.
rows.surviving_risk_axis: Context-dependent admissibility of the same evolved skill across target model × trigger × installed-skill/workflow context remains a useful evaluation axis, but not a standalone paper thesis under the current formulation.
strongest_same_information_baselines: Skill Trust and Lifecycle Governance gates/tiers with context-aware verification features
ChainGuard-style candidate+installed-skill context analysis followed by graduated permission assignment
generic contextual constrained decision/risk-sensitive policy using identical model/trigger/workflow/security/utility features
MASA-style model-conditioned skill adaptation plus a security gate
revival_requirements: State an ex-ante prediction that cannot be expressed by a contextual constrained policy using exactly the same model/trigger/workflow/utility/security evidence.
Show that the same skill's admissibility has a structural non-separability/impossibility property, not merely model dependence or composition dependence.
Beat lifecycle-governance and ChainGuard-derived decision rules under the same information and false-positive/utility budget.
Do not use a new scalar score, trust tier, permission tier, scanner, or hard veto as the novelty claim.
rows.cheapest_problem_falsifier: Construct the candidate's intended install/update/block/escalate labels on a small matched table, then fit or hand-compile a generic contextual constrained policy with the identical target-model, trigger, installed-skill/workflow, utility, and security observations. If it reproduces the decisions, the revised object has no irreducible paper novelty.
rows.next_action: Stop standalone SP-09. Preserve context-dependent admissibility as a risk/baseline axis for future skill-evolution papers; reopen only with a non-separability/impossibility result beyond contextual governance.

rows.original_problem: The explicit-procedure boundary of query-only skill retrieval.
rows.collision_reason: Implicit query difficulty, reasoning-enhanced query-only retrieval, task decomposition, structured multi-skill routing, query-conditional skill-set compatibility, same-capability ambiguity, and typed structural retrieval are already occupied. The original explicit-versus-implicit procedural boundary is therefore not sufficient novelty.
rows.revised_problem: Given an observable user query q and a fixed skill library L under query-only inference, is the minimally sufficient capability/skill set point-identifiable from q at all? If multiple task semantics that are observationally compatible with the same q require incompatible sufficient skill sets, retrieval is structurally non-identifiable and a system must abstain or acquire additional information rather than merely rerank more strongly.
rows.irreducible_boundary_required: The claim must be about observational non-identifiability of the sufficient skill set, not about implicit queries being harder, decomposition improving retrieval, multi-skill compatibility, same-capability representative risk, or a new clarification policy. The paper must separate 'retriever failed to infer latent steps' from 'no query-only retriever can identify one sufficient set from the available information'.
strongest_same_information_baselines: SkillWeaver / SkillReranker task decomposition and structured reranking
generic partial identification over latent task interpretations
generic clarification-need prediction / active query refinement
required_problem_revision: Define an observational equivalence relation over task semantics that produce the same available query representation and map each semantic state to a sufficient capability/skill set.
Define point-identifiable, set-identifiable, and non-identifiable retrieval cases before introducing any learned method.

Require matched examples where the observable query is held fixed or information-equivalent while compatible latent task semantics require incompatible sufficient skill sets; simple short-vs-long or explicit-vs-implicit pairs are insufficient.
Show that an oracle ranker with the same query information cannot resolve the non-identifiable cases; otherwise the issue is model quality rather than information structure.
Audit against generic selective prediction, partial identification, and clarification policies using exactly the same ambiguity set/evidence.
Do not claim task decomposition, capability reasoning, top-rank-versus-coverage metrics, or abstention itself as novelty.
rows.cheapest_problem_falsifier: Before method design, inventory existing SkillReason/SkillRet/CompSkillBench/R3-Skill/SkillResolve-style assets for query-level units where one observable or information-equivalent query admits multiple plausible task semantics with incompatible sufficient skill sets. If no such units exist, or if a generic uncertainty/clarification baseline using the same information resolves them, stop the revised problem.
rows.next_action: Run a data-only support inventory for query-level non-identifiability. Advance to method design only if nonzero matched units survive source/provenance and generic partial-identification/clarification reduction checks.
